Job Title: AI Upskilling & Adoption Lead (12-month maternity cover)

Department: AI Upskilling & Adoption, IT

Location: Ballerup, Greater Copenhagen, Denmark

As AI Upskilling & Adoption Lead, you will help colleagues and leaders make AI a practical part of their everyday work. In this 12-month maternity cover, you will turn business needs into tailored AI sessions for leadership teams and functional audiences, and carry learning from our global AI events into follow-up and knowledge sharing. You will own defined initiatives and help shape what comes next, so people use AI tools with confidence.

Your new role

**Responsibilities

**You will take ownership of agreed activities within AI enablement and enterprise AI events, while contributing to other priorities across AI Upskilling & Adoption. Your key responsibilities will include:

• Turning stakeholder needs and insights into relevant demonstrations of approved AI tools such as Microsoft 365 Copilot and ChatGPT Enterprise, learning sessions and hands-on exercises.

• Guiding the development of presentations and learning materials, so they are relevant, high quality and consistent with the Enterprise AI narrative and approved guidance.

• Defining success measures and overseeing participant resources, feedback and follow-up, using evidence and lessons learned to improve learning outcomes and future initiatives.

• Developing reusable approaches, documentation and templates, and acting as a specialist resource for colleagues, building relationships that support continuity and knowledge sharing.

• Recommending improvements for future Enterprise AI events and, where assigned, leading planning and delivery across programme, production, communications and local engagement.

• Working independently within agreed priorities, managing plans and dependencies, resolving delivery challenges and escalating risks or decisions that need wider alignment.

Some travel to other Novo Nordisk offices in Denmark may be required for AI upskilling events.

Your new department

You will join AI Upskilling & Adoption within IT at Novo Nordisk, reporting to Tamari Ladbye-Hansen. The team helps colleagues understand the business potential of AI and build the confidence to use approved tools in their everyday work.

Day to day, you will partner with leadership teams, functional audiences, business colleagues, subject-matter experts and delivery partners. You will also work with colleagues across programme, production, communications and local engagement to deliver global AI events. You will align expectations early, keep dependencies visible and speak up when something needs a decision, so work keeps moving.

**Your Skills And Qualifications

**You combine hands-on AI knowledge with strong facilitation and project management skills. You can quickly understand a business audience, make AI relevant to their work and coordinate the people and activities needed to deliver a useful experience.

**We Are Looking For Someone Who Brings

**

• Experience in AI adoption, digital enablement or learning and development, translating business needs into practical learning activities.

• Hands-on experience with Microsoft 365 Copilot and ChatGPT Enterprise, including creating skills and guidance materials, testing demonstrations and explaining capabilities and limitations.

• Strong presentation and facilitation skills, with the confidence to engage senior leadership teams, support hands-on exercises and respond to questions.

• Project management experience, including coordinating interconnected workstreams, milestones, dependencies, risks and decisions.

• Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to align expectations and work effectively with business colleagues, subject-matter experts and delivery partners.

• Sound judgement when selecting internal information and preparing examples for responsible AI use.

• The ability to own agreed deliverables independently, adapt to changing priorities and contribute across the team.

The following experience would be useful, but is not essential:

• Planning or delivering global, hybrid or broadcast events.

• Designing learning experiences for executive or functional leadership audiences.

• Supporting employee engagement through champion networks and local teams.

• Using participation data, feedback and other measures to improve learning or engagement activities.

• Creating reusable presentations, learning resources, project templates and delivery playbooks.

We welcome different professional backgrounds that bring together AI knowledge, learning, stakeholder engagement and structured delivery.

Working at Novo Nordisk

Every day we seek the solutions that defeat serious chronic diseases. To do this, we approach our work with determination, constant curiosity and a commitment to finding better ways forward. For over 100 years, this dedication has driven us to build a company focused on lasting change for long-term health. One where diverse thinking, shared purpose and mutual respect come together to create extraordinary results. As we continue our digital transformation journey, you'll find exciting opportunities to grow your expertise while working alongside talented colleagues who share your passion for excellence. When you join us, you're not just optimizing processes you're enabling innovations that span generations.

What we offer

At Novo Nordisk, you’ll join a global healthcare company with a unique culture and strong results. We offer continuous learning, career development, and benefits tailored to your life and career stage.

You will work at the forefront of AI and technology, as Novo upskills its workforce to advance AI as a driver of innovation for people living with serious chronic diseases. You will be trusted to own your initiatives, make your voice heard and contribute across the team’s priority streams.

You will build new skills through hands-on delivery, work with senior leaders and colleagues across functions, and be supported to perform at your best. Clear expectations help you focus on the outcomes that matter.

This is a 12-month maternity cover contract. The team works together in the office Tuesday to Thursday, with flexibility on Monday and Friday.

Salary

For this role, the Annual Base Salary ranges from 742,600.00 DKK to 1,091,600.00 DKK, corresponding to the level of the position.

The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience.

Incentives and Benefits: The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives as well as other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area, and relevant market benchmarks.

Learn more about our Reward Philosophy https://www.novonordisk.com/careers/working-at-novo-nordisk/total-rewards-benefits.html

Start now

Your impact begins today. If you are ready to help colleagues and leaders use AI with confidence in their everyday work, apply for the AI Upskilling & Adoption Lead role by 23 November 2026. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

**About The Job

**As a Medical Affairs Intern - Neurology, you will gain hands-on experience within the Medical Affairs team of a global pharmaceutical company, contributing to a research project that combines scientific literature reviews with insights from clinical experts.

You will have the opportunity to explore complex scientific topics, support research activities, and engage with healthcare professionals to better understand clinical practices and patient needs. Working closely with an experienced Medical Advisor, you will develop your scientific research, communication, and stakeholder engagement skills in a collaborative environment.

This internship may also provide an opportunity to connect your practical experience with your academic studies or Master's thesis, subject to university requirements and agreement.

Ready to grow your skills while helping shape the future of healthcare? At Sanofi, you’ll be empowered to learn, ask questions, and bring your ideas to life – all while supported by inspiring mentors and collaborative teams.

**Main Responsibilities

**

• Conduct structured scientific literature reviews to identify, assess, and summarise existing research findings.

• Assist in preparing and coordinating interviews with neurologists to better understand clinical practices and patient needs.

• Help gather, organise, and interpret insights from healthcare professionals, comparing findings with published scientific evidence.

• Prepare clear summaries, reports, and presentations to communicate research findings and project Progress.

• Collaborate closely with the Medical Affairs team and contribute to scientific discussions and ongoing project activities.

**About You

**To excel in this role you will need to have:

• Currently pursuing a Master’s degree in Medicine, Neuroscience, Health Sciences, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Public Health, or a related discipline.

• Strong interest in Medical Affairs, scientific research, and gaining experience within the pharmaceutical industry.

• Ability to understand, critically evaluate, and summarise complex scientific information.

• Strong organisational skills, with a structured and systematic approach to research and project activities.

• Good communication and interpersonal skills, with the confidence and willingness to engage with healthcare professionals and other stakeholders.

• Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with colleagues.

• Strong English communication skills, both written and verbal, with the confidence to engage in scientific discussions with healthcare professionals.

**Additional Experience That Would Be Beneficial

**

• Previous academic or practical experience involving multiple sclerosis, other neuroimmunological disorders, or patients living with these conditions.

• Experience conducting systematic literature reviews, qualitative research, and/or working with real-world data.

**About Sanofi

**We’re an R&D-driven, AI-powered biopharma company committed to improving people’s lives and delivering compelling growth. Our deep understanding of the immune system – and innovative pipeline – enables us to invent medicines and vaccines that treat and protect millions of people around the world. Together, we chase the miracles of science to improve people’s lives.

**Why choose us?

**

• Stretch your skills through apprenticeships, internships, graduate programs, and international experiences that grow with you.

• Learn from inspiring mentors and collaborative teams while contributing to real projects that shape the future of healthcare.

• Build your future with access to the latest tools, digital innovation, and continuous learning that keep you ahead of the curve.

• Grow in a purpose-driven company where your voice matters and your work helps improve millions of lives.

• Thrive in inclusive, flexible workplaces that support your personal and professional well-being.

• Launch your career with a company that invests in you — and empowers you to reimagine what’s possible.

Based at our welcoming Roskilde office, you will join the Workplace department, which develops and maintains BEC’s cloud-based Microsoft platform, including SharePoint and Microsoft 365 administration services, for BEC and our 25 Danish banking customers.

As a Senior Microsoft 365 Platform/System Engineer, you will join a team of dedicated professionals focused on developing SharePoint and Microsoft 365 within our Modern Workplace services.

You will be part of a cross-country, agile Microsoft 365 team comprising 12 dedicated professionals.

At BEC, we value regular in-office collaboration while offering flexibility to work remotely for up to eight days per month. You will report to Anne-Mette Bluhme.

**

• Developing and managing SharePoint Online Services

• Administering and maintaining the Microsoft 365 suite, including Copilot, Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, Teams and OneDrive for Business

• Ensuring the availability, performance, and security of these services

• Implementing and managing security controls for Microsoft 365 environments, ensuring compliance with industry standards and regulatory requirements

• Participation in development projects of new services

• Developing and maintaining PowerShell scripts to automate administrative tasks and improve efficiency

• Handling second-line Microsoft 365 incidents and service requests

**

• Solid experience in SharePoint development and maintenance

• Solid experience administering Microsoft 365 services

**

• Experience in the financial sector

**Be your best self with BEC's benefits!

• Professional development budget

• Healthy, varied lunch and fruit in the canteen

• Active staff associations: yoga, cycling, go-karting, games, bowling etc.

**What does the recruitment process look like?

**

• Send us your CV: We want to get to know you

• Screening call: Let's chat and see if we're a match

• Meet your future manager and team: See who you'll be working closely with.

If you have any questions about the position, please contact Development Manager Anne-Mette Bluhme at abz@bec.dk.

BEC is in the process of being acquired by our largest customer and co-owner, Nykredit, which is Denmark's largest mortgage provider and third-largest bank. We will become part of a new and larger organization called Nykredit Financial Technologies. In the transition phase, we are recruiting for roles that we expect to be highly needed in our future organization.

The role

As our Revenue Operations Manager, you'll own the processes and data behind our sales organization: the sales process, definitions, forecasting and commissions.

This is an individual contributor role in our Revenue Operations team, reporting to the Global Director, Revenue Operations & Information Security. You'll be supported by the RevOps team and work closely with sales leadership and Finance. We're looking for around 5+ years of hands-on experience in VC or PE-backed companies.

What you'll do

Forecasting

• Define shared sales terms and metrics such as pipeline, stage probabilities, bookings, and new versus expansion business.

• Establish a forecasting baseline: forecast categories, submission rules and a first method for new business and expansion.

• Track forecast accuracy and refine the method as data quality improves.

• Build pipeline and forecast reports and dashboards in Salesforce.

• Set up a pipeline and forecast review cadence with sales leadership once the definitions are in place.

Sales process

• Own the sales process from qualified opportunity to closed deal, including stages, exit criteria and the hand-over to delivery and Finance.

• Set up territories, account ownership and rules for partner and cross-sell deals.

Commissions

• Help automate the commission process with the right tooling, from data capture to calculation and payout.

• Work with Finance and sales leadership on plan design and changes.

Sales systems

• Shape how Salesforce (including Revenue Cloud/CPQ) supports the sales process, and make hands-on changes where needed.

• Keep sales data clean with required fields, validation rules and deduplication.

• Automate manual steps in the sales process with workflows and AI.

• Work with CRM vendors and implementation partners, including evaluations, renewals, support and new functionality.

• Train and support sales reps on system and process changes.

Stack harmonization

We grow through acquisition. In October 2026 we announced our combination with WoodWing, adding four products and more than 200 colleagues. Harmonizing the sales stack and processes of acquired companies is a big part of this job, done together with the RevOps team and the Global Director, Revenue Operations & Information Security.

• Bring each acquired sales team, starting with WoodWing, onto our shared sales process, pipeline stages, definitions and reporting.

• Move acquired sales reps onto group commission plans.

• Set account ownership and cross-sell rules between entities, and resolve duplicate accounts.

• Assess each acquired company's sales systems and migrate accounts, contacts, opportunities and products into Salesforce in phases, including from HubSpot.

• Build a repeatable playbook for the next acquisition.

Your qualifications

Essential

• Around 5+ years in Revenue Operations or Sales Operations in B2B SaaS

• Experience building a sales forecast from the ground up, including the definitions and data quality behind it

• Hands-on Salesforce experience, including reports, dashboards and flows

• Experience designing and rolling out sales processes

• Experience administering sales commissions

• Experience consolidating CRMs or sales processes after an acquisition, or running sales operations across several entities

• Good understanding of sales metrics such as pipeline coverage, win rates, sales cycle and bookings

• Strong analytical skills in Excel or Google Sheets

Nice to have

• HubSpot experience, including migrating from HubSpot to Salesforce

• Salesforce Revenue Cloud or CPQ experience

• Experience implementing commission software

• Using AI in sales workflows

Soft skills

You're comfortable with change and ambiguity, as our processes keep developing with each acquisition. You build trust with sales leaders and sales reps, prefer practical solutions you can improve over time, and help new colleagues adapt to shared ways of working.

What kind of company is Omnidocs?

We recognize that in different phases of life, you need different kinds of flexibility, and we are happy to provide that. It could be that you prefer to work from home once or twice a week or occasionally need to leave early for a soccer tournament, a parents’ meeting, or a romantic date. We find small talk between co-workers valuable, so your lunch break is part of your working hours, and we invest in quality coffee beans for the cozy and useful interactions across teams by the coffee machine. It may sound like little things, but the overall message is that we want you to meet trust, kindness, and helpfulness at work because we expect that this is what you bring as well. The purpose of our company is just as internal as it is externally communicated: We make every workday work better.

We also love to connect. We do social activities such as LAN parties, board game afternoons, and Friday Cafes. Our office is located in the heart of the historic neighborhood of Christianshavn, surrounded by canals and great little cafés and restaurants. We have plenty of light and air while being close to everything – including the metro, the canals, and the city center.

**Join the world’s oldest start-up and turn up the volume on your career

**We are seeking an Embedded Software Developer with DevOps experience to join our R&D Headset department in Ballerup. This is where technologically advanced Jabra communication and music products are born, and you will be at the heart of our innovation.

You will join a team of proficient embedded software engineers eager to work with you. Together, we are responsible for the entire development lifecycle – specification, design, implementation, and testing – for GN's highly acclaimed enterprise audio devices. Our primary focus is on world-class Bluetooth, BLE, and LE Audio Headset solutions that connect the world**.

****What will you be doing?

****As Embedded Software Developer, You Will

**

• Work directly in a large C-based ESW platform which includes code for external partners

• Implement, maintain and refactor embedded C code for our ESW platforms and products

• Contribute to integration of new features and bug fixing across the full software stack

• Collaborate closely with other embedded developers on design, code reviews and troubleshooting

• Based on your DevOps experience, you will assist our dedicated Embedded Software DevOps team in creating the best-in-class CI/CD and AI framework together with our Embedded Software architects

**To Thrive In This Role, You Should Possess

**

• 5+ years of professional experience with embedded software development and automated software test frameworks

• 5+ years of C programming skills and experience with embedded systems, microcontrollers, and RTOS

• 2+ years of professional experience with CI/CD pipelines for embedded software and AI-assisted workflows development

• Solid experience in navigating and contributing to large, complex codebases and SDKs from chip vendors

• Experience with Bluetooth wireless technologies – practical proficiency with Bluetooth Classic, Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE), and familiarity with LE Audio

• Experience in scripting and Automation (Python and Makefile)

• Fluent written and spoken English

**Beyond Your Technical Skills

**You are a curious, logical thinker who enjoys solving problems and thrives in a constant learning environment at the edge of technology. You like to combine active coding with building smart automation.

You manage your time effectively and work through issues through each stage, from analysis to implementation and automated quality assurance. Furthermore, you contribute positively to a shared goal where we succeed together as a team.

At GN we pride ourselves on encouraging flexible working whenever possible. We trust our people to fulfill their responsibilities, to know when in-person collaboration is better than hybrid, and to be present when it's needed most.

**We are focused on an inclusive recruitment process

**All applicants will receive equal consideration for employment. As such, we encourage you to submit your CV without a photo to ensure an equal and fair application process.

Should you have any special requirements for the interview, please let the Hiring Manager know upon accepting invitation to interview.

**How to apply?

**Use the ‘APPLY’ link before 30 November 2026. Applications are assessed on a continuous basis, so don’t wait to send yours.

On a time crunch? Feel free to only submit your up-to-date CV including a few sentences outlining your motivation for applying – quick and easy.

If you would like to know more about the position, please contact hiring manager Ole Gudiksen, ESW Platform, at olgudiksen@gn.group.

**Join us in bringing people closer

**GN brings people closer through our advanced intelligent hearing, audio, video, and gaming solutions. Inspired by people and motivated by innovation, we deliver technology that enhances the senses of hearing and sight. We enable people with hearing loss overcome real-life problems, improve communication and collaboration for businesses and provide great experiences for audio and gaming enthusiasts.

GN Store Nord A/S has entered into a definitive agreement for the sale of GN’s Hearing business to Amplifon S.p.A. to create a global leader in audiology. For GN Group, this creates an opportunity to further expand our position in the large audio and video peripherals markets. Read more about the announcement here: GN Store Nord A/S enters into agreement to sell its Hearing business to Amplifon S.p.A. for DKK 17.0 billion - [Mar 16, 2026]

**A career at Hitachi Rail will help create a legacy. With operations in every corner of the world, our work goes to the cutting-edge of digital transformation and technology. **Job Description:

****About The Role

**Are you an experienced IT Infrastructure Engineer who enjoys getting hands-on with complex systems and solving technical challenges? We are looking for an IT Infrastructure Engineer to join Hitachi Rail in Ballerup and support the delivery of IT infrastructure for critical railway systems in Denmark.

As our new IT Infrastructure Engineer, you will play a key role in designing, implementing, testing, troubleshooting and supporting the central IT systems for critical infrastructure projects. Working closely with infrastructure elements, network, cybersecurity, application, and operations teams, you will help ensure reliable, secure, and high-performing platforms across both laboratory and production environments.

This hands-on role covers the administration and support of physical and virtual servers based on VMware and ESXi environments, Linux operating systems, Active Directory/LDAP/Radius authentication services, DNS, NTP, networking, certificate management (PKI), backup and restore solutions, and storage technologies (RAID, SAN, NAS). You will be responsible for maintaining infrastructure availability and operational readiness while supporting deployment, testing and troubleshooting.

Throughout the project lifecycle, you will contribute to the solution deployment of the IT infrastructure, validation, migration, documentation, and operational handover. Working closely with internal teams, suppliers, and project stakeholders, you will support the successful delivery and long-term operation of critical infrastructure systems in a safety-critical environment.

**What you will be doing:

**

• Administer and support physical and virtual server infrastructure, ensuring availability, performance, high availability and security.

• Manage and maintain VMware ESXi/vCenter environments, including installation, configuration, monitoring, and troubleshooting.

• Administer Linux-based systems, including patching, performance monitoring, and operational support.

• Manage core infrastructure services, Syslog servers, Active Directory/LDAP/Radius, DNS, NTP, routing, and network connectivity.

• Support and maintain storage solutions (RAID, SAN/NAS), server hardware, and enterprise IT infrastructure components.

• Manage PKI and digital certificates, including certificate deployment, renewal, and lifecycle management.

• Administer and support backup and recovery solutions, ensuring successful restore and disaster recovery capabilities.

• Participate in infrastructure testing, deployment, migration, and operational handover activities.

• Troubleshoot and resolve infrastructure issues, perform root-cause analysis, and implement corrective actions.

• Maintain technical documentation and collaborate with infrastructure, cybersecurity, network, and operations teams.

• Support infrastructure environments within safety-critical and regulated industries, such as railway, transportation, or industrial systems

**

• Strong knowledge of Active Directory/LDAP/Radius, DNS, NTP, networking, storage (RAID, SAN, NAS), backup & recovery, Syslog Servers and certificate management (PKI).

Do you want to be a valued part of the critical infrastructure that serves communities across Europe and beyond? Are you looking for a position in which you can set direction and help shape our company? If so, then you could be the newest addition to our team as Finance Business Partner.

**Be part of the movement – and play your part

****About The Role

**DFDS operates through two divisions – Logistics and Ferry. In this role, you will join the central Business Finance team for the Logistics Division and take part in how financial performance is measured, steered, and improved across a rapidly growing European logistics business. You will report to the Head of Central Business Finance Logistics, who reports to the Divisional CFO Logistics.

The central Business Finance team holds ownership of all core financial planning, reporting, functional finance, and commercial support activities of the Logistics Division. You will join a team of four Finance Business Partners in Copenhagen and two Business Analysts in our Shared Service Center in Poznan.

**Within The Team, You Will Take Responsibilities In

**

• Driving the divisional monthly- and quarterly performance cycle, incl. reporting and budgeting

• Driving improvement initiatives for the reporting framework, automation and data quality

• Engaging in improvement initiatives in the data models, and planning frameworks relevant to the performance cycle

• Supporting the adoption of new KPI frameworks and models for risk assessment to the performance outlook

• Supporting financial insight and decision material to senior stakeholders in central functions

• Financial processes, data models and analytical tooling incl. usage of EPM, BI and AI tools

Further, you will work closely with the Group FP&A team and the Senior Finance Business Partners across business units to ensure aligned financial processes, shared standards, and timely reporting.

Your role will be hands on, performing reporting- and analytical activities, together with a team that sits at the centre of the division’s performance agenda.

You will be based at our headquarters in Copenhagen and join a driven and dedicated Business Finance team where colleagues work closely together, support each other, and take pride in driving clarity and impact for the business. The division has more than tripled in size in recent years, and the business finance function is at the core of driving performance in this setting.

**About You

**You thrive in a role that combines the recurrent periodic reporting activities with hands-on analytical work, contributing to the strategic direction for the division. With this in mind, we imagine that the ideal candidate brings:

• +2 years of experience within FP&A or Business Finance, preferably from large, international, or complex organisations

• Understanding of financial processes, planning cycles, P&L, balance sheet and cash flow

• Strong analytical skills and structured problem solving abilities

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills

• A collaborative mindset and strong personal drive

• Fundamental understanding of EPM or ERP systems (e.g., OneStream/HFM, D365/SAP/Oracle or similar)

• Experience with and/or interest in leveraging AI to improve reporting, analysis, and ways of working

• Experience in the logistics sector and project management is a plus, but not required

A degree in finance, economics, business administration, or similar is expected. Full professional proficiency in English is required.

We think the strongest teams are built on diversity and inclusivity. Contrasting opinions, varied skills, and strong characters bring out the best in us all. And we cannot wait for you to join.

**Working at DFDS

****Join the movement and grow with us

**As part of the Logistics Division - a business that has tripled in size over recent years - you will be at the heart of major strategic transformation as the division works to develop its network and digitise a traditionally manual industry.

While you’re with us, we want you to develop. At DFDS, development happens first and foremost through real work. We will also offer training and support when needed.

We promote a great workplace with a diverse and vibrant community. At our Copenhagen headquarters, we enjoy a modern workspace with award-winning facilities, different work zones, own game room, fitness facilities, canteen and a café with a rooftop terrace with a beautiful ocean view, all just 5 minutes from the nearest train & metro station.

jobs.description:
We are looking for an experienced, motivated and independent laboratory technician/laboratory manager to join a newly established research group at the Biotech Research and Innovation Centre (BRIC), University of Copenhagen, investigating the molecular mechanisms of synaptic plasticity.

  We particularly welcome applications from experienced laboratory technicians seeking a long-term role in a research group.

  As the first member of the new research group, you will work closely with the group leader to establish the laboratory from the ground up. The position combines hands-on experimental work with responsibility for laboratory organization and offers the opportunity to play a central role in shaping how the laboratory develops as the group grows. We hope to build a lasting working relationship with a colleague who enjoys taking ownership of laboratory operations and experimental methods.

  Information on the department can be found at: https://www.bric.ku.dk/

   

  Our research

  Our research aims to understand how neuronal connections respond and adapt to activity, with a particular focus on the local molecular mechanisms regulating synaptic function and plasticity. We are particularly interested in how RNA localization and local protein synthesis are spatially organized at synapses, and how these processes contribute to activity-dependent changes in neuronal connectivity.

  We combine molecular and cellular neuroscience with advanced imaging, transcriptomic and proteomic approaches to investigate these questions across different types of synapses, including conventional neuronal synapses and specialized synapses of the retina.

  We are establishing a new research group at BRIC and aim to build an ambitious, collaborative and supportive team with open communication, high scientific standards and shared responsibility. As the first member of the laboratory, you will have a unique opportunity to contribute to its development from the beginning.

   

  Your job

  You will work closely with the group leader during the initial establishment of the laboratory and, as the team expands, become a central technical and organizational point of contact for the group.

  Your tasks will include:

   	
• Helping establish the laboratory, including ordering systems, stocks, equipment, documentation and shared laboratory resources. 	
• Establishing, documenting and maintaining laboratory protocols, procedures and experimental workflows. 	
• Contributing to hands-on experimental work and supporting ongoing research projects. 	
• Implementing, optimizing and troubleshooting new experimental methods. 	
• Onboarding and training new students, postdoctoral researchers and other group members in laboratory procedures and experimental techniques. 	
• Helping ensure continuity in laboratory procedures, experimental workflows and technical knowledge as the group grows. 	
• Coordinating shared laboratory activities and contributing to an efficient, safe and well-organized research environment.   The position is expected to develop together with the research group. Initially, there will be a strong focus on establishing the laboratory and experimental workflows. As the team grows, the role is expected to increasingly combine hands-on research with laboratory coordination, training and technical support.

   

  Profile

  We are looking for a motivated, independent and collaborative colleague who enjoys taking responsibility and contributing to the development of a new research environment. Substantial hands-on laboratory experience, reliability and an interest in long-term technical stewardship are particularly valued; a PhD is not required.

  Essential experience and skills

   	
• Relevant training as a laboratory technician, biomedical laboratory scientist or equivalent, or comparable professional experience in a biomedical research environment. 	
• Demonstrated experience working independently in a biomedical research laboratory and taking responsibility for experimental workflows, laboratory procedures or shared laboratory activities. 	
• Broad practical laboratory experience and the ability to implement and troubleshoot experimental procedures. 	
• Strong organizational skills and the ability to prioritize and follow tasks through to completion. 	
• Good communication and collaboration skills. 	
• A proactive and solution-oriented approach to laboratory work. 	
• An interest in sharing knowledge and training students and other researchers. 	
• Good written and spoken English.   Desirable experience and skills:

  Experience in one or more of the following areas would be an advantage:

   	
• Laboratory organization or management, including ordering, stocks, equipment or shared laboratory resources. 	
• Establishing, documenting and troubleshooting experimental protocols. 	
• Molecular biology and RNA or protein biochemistry. 	
• Cell culture, including neuronal cell culture. 	
• Microscopy and imaging. 	
• Tissue processing and histological techniques. 	
• Experimental animal models. 	
• Experience working with neural tissue, particularly retinal tissue, would be an advantage   We do not expect you to have experience with all techniques used in the group. Training can be provided for the right person. We particularly value applicants who are interested in taking ownership of their role, developing new skills and growing with the research group while contributing to its long-term development. Applicants with extensive practical laboratory experience are encouraged to apply regardless of publication record.

   

  Place of employment

  The place of employment is at the Biotech Research and Innovation Centre (BRIC), Faculty of Health and Medical Sciences, University of Copenhagen. BRIC provides a dynamic and international

  We aim to create a supportive and highly collaborative research environment with open communication, high scientific standards and a strong sense of shared responsibility. The position offers considerable independence and the opportunity to develop a broad and central role as the research group grows.

   

  Terms of employment

  The average weekly working hours are 37 hours per week.

  The position is a fixed-term position limited to a period of 3 years. The starting date is 1 February 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter.

  Employment as laboratory technician will be in accordance with the agreement between the Danish Ministry of Finance and OAO/HK STAT. The position is placed in salary group 4.

  Employment will be in accordance with the provisions of the collective agreement between the Danish Ministry of Taxation and AC (the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations). The monthly salary will be based on the number of years of work experience (seniority) with the possibility to negotiate a salary supplement based on prior experiences and qualifications. The employer will pay an additional 18.07 % to your pension fund.

  Foreign and Danish applicants may be eligible for tax reductions, if they hold a PhD degree and have not lived in Denmark the last 10 years.

  The position is covered by the Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities 2020.

   

  Questions

  For further information regarding the position, please contact Eva Kaulich, Associate Professor and Group Leader, BRIC, University of Copenhagen: eva.kaulich@bric.ku.dk

   

  Application

  Your application should be submitted in English and include:

   	
• Motivated letter of application (max. one page). 	
• CV incl. education, work/research experience, language skills and other skills relevant for the position. 	
• Copies of relevant educational or professional qualifications (for example, laboratory technician or biomedical laboratory scientist training certificates); a PhD is not required. 	
• Optional: a brief description of relevant laboratory methods, technical responsibilities or laboratory management experience. Publications are not required.   Please submit your application by clicking on “Apply Now” below. Only online applications will be accepted.

   

  Deadline for applications: 2 December 2026, 23.59pm CET 

  We reserve the right not to consider material received after the deadline, and not to consider applications that do not live up to the abovementioned requirements.

   

  The further process 

  After the expiry of the deadline for applications, the authorized recruitment manager selects applicants for assessment on the advice of the hiring committee. All applicants are then immediately notified whether their application has been passed for assessment by an unbiased assessor. Once the assessment work has been completed each applicant has the opportunity to comment on the part of the assessment that relates to the applicant him/herself.

  You can read about the recruitment process at http://employment.ku.dk/faculty/recruitment-process/

  The applicant will be assessed according to the Ministerial Order no. 242 of 13 March 2012 on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities.

   

  Interviews are expected to be held in week 49-50

  The University of Copenhagen wish to reflect the diversity of society and encourage all qualified candidates to apply regardless of personal background.

Job description
We are looking for candidates who can strengthen our research profile. A significant part of our work involves collaboration with industry partners, and we often carry out applied research. Therefore, it is important that candidates conduct research on topics relevant to modern companies, and candidates with research activities involving industry will be preferred.

Research disciplines relevant to the position include:

• 
Mechanical or electrical engineering with a focus on energy systems

• 
Mechanical engineering with a focus on product management and/or product development

• 
Industrial engineering with a focus on operations management and/or supply chain management

Candidates are expected to teach and supervise students at all levels, including PhD students. Our portfolio of engineering study programmes consists of an MSc in Engineering (Technology Based Business Development) as well as two Bachelor of Engineering programmes in Forretningsudvikling (Business Development) and Global Management and Manufacturing. Teaching will primarily take place within these programmes, although teaching in our IT and business engineering programmes may also become relevant.

Permanent employment as associate professor at Aarhus BSS requires completion of, within a two year period, the supervision course and also the course Online and blended learning provided by Centre for Educational Development at Aarhus University.

Non-Danish speakers are required to acquire a working knowledge of Danish within the first 3 years of employment. Where relevant, the department will grant time off from teaching duties to attend Danish courses during the first two years of employment.

Your qualifications
Employment as an associate professor requires a PhD degree and a strong academic background as assistant professor or equivalent. Furthermore, we prefer applicants with the following qualifications:

• 
A proven record of strong international research, as evidenced by publications in highly reputed international journals.

• 
A track record of excellence in teaching on topics relevant to our study programmes.

• 
A clear, well-developed and viable strategy for future high-level research.

• 
A track record of good citizenship in the wider academic community, combined with a commitment to contributing to a vibrant work environment within our department.

• 
A commitment to sharing insights and knowledge with the broader society and to prioritising dialogue with practitioners.

• 
A commitment to providing teaching that equips students with relevant competences and fosters their ability to reflect critically on business topics.

• 
A willingness to engage in external research funding activities.

The required qualifications are elaborated below:
Applicants must have produced and published research in addition to their PhD thesis and must demonstrate continued academic development through research publications that go beyond the PhD thesis either thematically, theoretically, methodologically and/or empirically.

Applicants must have at least three articles published or accepted for publications in high-standard, international, peer-reviewed journals. A significant part must have been produced after completion of the PhD degree. Furthermore, substantial publications must have been produced within the previous five years.

Applicants must document significant teaching experience. They must therefore have taught several courses, preferably at different levels and across a range of topics. Five courses are normally considered a minimum requirement.

Applicants must have some experience in conducting research collaboration, research management and knowledge dissemination, possibly including editorial experience and participation in collaborative research projects.

Application deadline
4 January 2027

Place of work
Birk Centerpark 15, DK-7400 Herning

The evaluation process
Shortlisting is applied. This means that an appointment committee (assisted by the chair of the assessment committee) advises the head of department on which applicants possess the qualifications, competencies, experience and potential described above under “Your qualifications”, notably in fields with specific departmental research and teaching needs and in accordance with the faculty’s criteria and guidelines for evaluating candidates to permanent positions.

Through the shortlisting process, the head of department selects the applicants who will receive a thorough assessment of their professional qualifications. The applicants will then be assessed by an expert assessment committee. All applicants will be notified whether or not their application has been shortlisted and forwarded to the assessment committee for evaluation. Shortlisted applicants will be informed about the composition of the committee.

Please note that the assessment of applicants is based solely on the material received prior to the application deadline.

Read more about the recruitment process, shortlisting procedure and guidelines for assessment committees here.

Further information

For further information about the position and the department, please contact Section Head Mirko Presser, tel. +45 3049 0976; email: mirko.presser@btech.au.dk.

If you need help uploading your application or have any questions about the recruitment process, please contact HR Coordinator, Charlotte Thomsen, tel.: +45 8716 5362; email: charlotte@au.dk.

Who we are

BTECH is part of Aarhus BSS, Aarhus University – a top-100 university. Aarhus BSS has achieved the triple-crown AASCB, AMBA and EQUIS accreditations. BTECH is located in the business-oriented and entrepreneurial city of Herning. The department excels in business, IT and engineering disciplines and emphasises the importance of company collaborations.

We have around 1,200 students and close to100 staff members. Each year, approximately 500 students engage in company projects across more than 250 companies, ranging from SMEs to leading multinationals. Our student incubator, Business Factory, launches ca. 10 new companies annually.

We influence society through business development and technology. For this reason, many research projects are carried out in close collaboration with industry, based on new data and emerging technologies. These projects receive generous support from the ERC, Horizon Europe, the Independent Research Fund Denmark and the Danish Industry Foundation, among others.

More information about BTECH is available here.

International applicant? 
Aarhus University offers a broad variety of services for international researchers and accompanying families, including relocation service and career counselling to expat partners. Please find more information here:
https://internationalstaff.au.dk/relocationservice/

Please find more information about research opportunities at Aarhus University here: http://international.au.dk/research/

Terms of employment
Salary and terms of employment are governed by the Cirkulære om overenskomst for akademikere i staten (in Danish). You will be employed as asssociate professor at base pay level 4–8 with additional supplements in accordance with the Cirkulære om protokollat om visse ansættelsesvilkår for videnskabeligt personale ved universiteter (in Danish).

The job content and qualification requirements are described in further detail in the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities.

Application procedure
When you apply for this position it is mandatory to attach the following:

• 
Application

• 
Curriculum Vitae. You are encouraged to declare any periods of leave without research activity, including, for example, maternity leave, since your research activities are assessed in relation to your actual research time

Education (diploma for master's, PhD and possibly higher doctoral degree)

List of publications (the enclosed publications must be clearly marked on the list of publications)

Publications. Up to five publications can be included in the application. In the event of several authors the publications must be accompanied by a co-author statement concerning the applicant's share of the collaborative work with the consent of the co-authors. This template may be used for the purpose

Teaching portfolio. The specific requirements regarding the documentation can be found here

Materials which cannot be uploaded together with the application may be submitted in five copies to Aarhus BSS HR & PhD, Aarhus University, Bartholins Allé 16, DK-8000 Aarhus C.

Read more about how to apply for an academic post at Aarhus BSS here

Aarhus University’s ambition is to be an attractive and inspiring workplace for all and to foster a culture in which each individual has opportunities to thrive, achieve and develop. We view equality and diversity as assets, and we welcome all applicants.

The application must be submitted via Aarhus University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aarhus University's website.

About Aarhus University

Aarhus University is an academically diverse and research-intensive university with a strong commitment to high-quality research and education and the development of society nationally and globally. jobs.occupation: Business Data Analyst, Falcom, GN Group
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Business Data Analyst to join our Commercial Operations team under the Program Management team and help turn commercial data into reliable, actionable insights for the business.

**Built on a proud legacy of more than 155 years of audio and technical solutions, Falcom delivers high-quality tactical communication systems, such as headsets, intercom systems, cables and connectors, sold to military and public safety users worldwide.

The role as Business Data Analyst is for someone who enjoys creating structure by building and maintaining data from HighStage, Excel and other business applications and is not always organized in the same way. You will not be expected to simply maintain existing reports, we are looking for someone who can build the structure behind them, challenge the data when something does not make sense, and continuously improve how we collect and organize information.

**The team you will be joining

**You will be based in our HQ in Ballerup and report to the Head of Program Management. You are expected to work independently, take ownership, and find motivation in contributing to the whole business. For our team to succeed we rely on trust, collaboration, and a positive, solution‑oriented mindset.

The role offers opportunities to grow. Over time, we expect you to take increasing ownership of our programs and sales data and help define how we use data across the business.

**Your Responsibilities

**You will work closely with Program Management, Sales and Operations to:

• Consolidate and analyse large datasets from HighStage, Excel and other business applications.

• Create structured datasets and identify fragmented, inconsistent or incomplete data inputs.

• Translate sales pipeline and program data into useful input for operational planning, forecasting and decision-making.

• Identify gaps and inconsistencies in our data and develop practical ways of improving data quality.

• Develop reporting and dashboards that create transparency across programs, opportunities, demand and deliveries.

• Work with stakeholders to understand what information they need and translate this into meaningful data and reporting.

• Support the development of our data structures as our systems and business processes evolve.

• Explore how AI and automation can improve the way we collect, structure, analyse and use business data.

**What We Are Looking For

**You probably have 2-5 years of relevant experience from a role within business analysis, data analysis, commercial operations, supply chain, or a similar field.

**We Expect That You

**

• Are highly skilled in Excel and comfortable working with large datasets.

• Have strong analytical skills and a structured approach to problem-solving.

• Can combine data from different sources and turn it into something useful for the business.

• Understand that good analysis requires both understanding the data and understanding the business behind it.

• Can communicate complex information in a simple and understandable way.

• Are fluent in written and spoken English.

Experience with tools such as Power BI, Power Query, SQL, Microsoft Dynamics 365 or similar platforms is an advantage, but not a requirement.

**Other Requirements For The Role

**Interest in AI is important. Hands-on experience using AI for analysis, automation or business processes is an advantage, but we are equally interested in someone who is curious and motivated to develop these capabilities.

Background check. Please note that all FalCom employees will be subject to a background check and must maintain a clean record throughout employment.

**We encourage you to apply

**Even if you don’t match all the above-mentioned skills, we welcome your application if you think you have transferable skills. We highly value a mindset and motivation that align with our core values, to not only ensure growth for you, but for your team and the wider GN organization as well.

**We are focused on an inclusive recruitment process

**All applicants will receive equal consideration for employment, which is why we encourage you to submit your CV without a photo.

Should you have any special requirements for the interview, please let the Hiring Manager know upon accepting the invitation to a potential first interview.

**How to apply?

**Use the ‘APPLY’ link no later than 27 November 2026. We review applications on an ongoing basis and will close the position once the right candidate is found, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

On a time crunch? Feel free to only submit your up-to-date CV, including a few sentences outlining your motivation for applying – quick and easy.

**Join us in bringing people closer

**FalCom is built on GN Group’s foundation, with 150+ years of innovation, as an established provider of intelligent audio solutions. Inspired by people and motivated by innovation, GN delivers technology that enhances hearing and sight. We enable people to overcome real-life problems, improve communication and collaboration for businesses, gamers, and tactical units.

GN Store Nord A/S has entered into a definitive agreement for the sale of GN’s Hearing business to Amplifon S.p.A. to create a global leader in audiology. For GN Group, this creates an opportunity to expand our position in the large audio and video peripherals markets. Read more about the announcement here.

**We hope you will join us on this journey and look forward to receiving your application.

Do you want to build and own the data pipelines that the rest of the business depends on? Then we have a skilled and ambitious team who would love to meet you!

Continia develops add-on solutions for Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central. Our solutions for accounts payable automation, e-documents, expense management and bank integration help more than 22,000 customers worldwide automate everyday finance processes, delivered through a global network of more than 2,200 reselling partners.

We are looking for a Data Engineer to join our Data & Reporting department. The department is responsible for business intelligence, integrations, and the machine learning and AI that run in production across the company.

You will be joining a small experienced team with different responsibilities on our platform, all owning a part of the setup.

About your role

Your focus will be on building and orchestrating data pipelines in Azure Data Factory and Databricks.

You will:

• Build, orchestrate and maintain data pipelines in Azure Data Factory and Databricks

• Ingest data from a broad range of source systems and land it reliably in our Data Lakehouse

• Write the SQL and Spark transformations that turn raw data into trusted, documented datasets

• Monitor, troubleshoot and improve pipelines already running in production

• Take ownership of data quality, lineage and documentation for the pipelines you build

• Work with the platform around the pipelines, including Unity Catalog, Event Hubs and Service Bus

• Collaborate with the colleagues who build our reporting and ML solutions on top of your data

You will work independently on your own tasks, with close sparring from experienced colleagues.

About you

SQL is your native language. It is the tool you reach for first, and you read, write and reason about it without thinking twice. You also:

• Have hands-on experience with Azure Data Factory, Databricks or similar pipeline and orchestration tools

• Know Python well enough to read, understand and modify code with confidence. You do not need to write it effortlessly

• Have worked with Spark or are keen to learn it

• Understand what Power BI and message-based technologies such as Service Bus are used for

• Work in a structured way, take ownership of what you build and are eager to learn

• Communicate comfortably in English. Danish is a plus but not a requirement

How we work with AI

Many of us use AI every day, and it is up to each person how much they use it. But we do not vibe-code our way into production. Code that goes live is code we understand, review and stand behind, and it meets our deployment standards like everything else. That is exactly why we need someone who can read and reason about code themselves instead of relying on a tool to do it for them.

What we offer

• Real pipelines in production from early on, with experienced colleagues to spar with

• A modern Azure data platform where you can influence how it develops

• A culture based on trust, responsibility and collaboration, where your ideas are taken seriously

• Opportunities for professional growth and learning

• A strong social environment where we celebrate successes and have fun together

• Work at the intersection of technology and business, with an impact you can see

The position is full-time with expected start in February. You will be based at our Aalborg office at Stigsborgvej 60, 9400 Nørresundby.

We work in a hybrid setup and are typically in the office three to four days a week, so fully remote work is not possible.

Ready to apply?

Send us your application and CV no later than 1 December. We review applications continuously and will reach out to candidates who match our needs.

Continia is committed to an inclusive recruitment process and equal opportunities for all applicants with a valid residence and/or work permit.

We look forward to hearing from you.

About Continia

At Continia, we value diversity and encourage authenticity. We are team players who respect each other's thoughts and ideas, and we expect everyone to take ownership of their work. We focus on personal and professional development to grow internally within our organization.

In our day-to-day work, we are pragmatic and result-oriented, and we aim to stay entrepreneurial by keeping things simple and focusing on our employees. We celebrate our wins and releases and aim to have one major event each year where all employees meet up in one place.

We recognize that time is what matters most. Continia solutions give customers more time every day to work and live. That's why "It's About Time" is our motto.

You’re happy to work through a queue of claims, but you’ll also ask whether there’s a simpler way to do something. For you, a useful tool is one that actually makes the work easier.

What we offer

At Actona Group, you’ll combine customer service, claims handling, and practical AI development. Working with real claims will give you a clear understanding of where the work takes time and where your ideas could help colleagues and customers.

You’ll work closely with the Aftersales team and colleagues in commercial and operational roles. Along the way, you’ll build experience in claims handling, process improvement, AI, and automation, and see how the changes you help introduce work in practice.

The position is based in Tvis, Holstebro.

Recruitment process

Please submit your application and CV via our recruitment system. Interviews will be conducted on an ongoing basis.

About Actona Group

Actona Group is an international furniture company headquartered in Denmark, operating in more than 90 countries. We develop, source, and sell modern furniture solutions to some of the world's leading retailers and private label customers.

We are on a continuous journey towards becoming a larger, stronger, and more sustainable company. We aim to create continued growth and value-adding services for the benefit of our customers and partners while minimizing our environmental impact.

Facts about Actona Group:

2,500 employees worldwide

• 
Headquarters, showroom, and European distribution centre in Tvis, Denmark

• 
Furniture production and local administration in Lithuania, Poland, and Ukraine

• 
Trading company in China

• 
Part of Lars Larsen Group

jobs.occupation: AI Innovation Engineer at Novo Nordisk Engineering
jobs.description:
If you’re energised by creating impactful AI solutions and thrive on curiosity, collaboration and rapid experimentation, we’d love to hear from you!

**Who We Are

**We are a leading pharma engineering company shaping the future of API pharma engineering globally. Leveraging the expertise of 2,000+ employees across Denmark, India, and the US, we design, build and optimise pharmaceutical manufacturing facilities that are essential to the health and well-being of patients everywhere.

Our success is driven by passion, innovation, and collaboration — with our customers and across our teams and disciplines. If you share our dedication to a noble cause and our passion for API pharma engineering, then NNE is the place for you.

**About The Role

**We are looking for an AI Innovation Engineer to join the IT Development and Data team in Global IT, our central IT organization. You will be part of the team’s AI engineering capability, with a strong focus on rapid experimentation and exploring how AI can solve real business problems. You will work closely with business stakeholders, subject-matter experts and AI Partners to explore opportunities and quickly test what works.

In this role, your technical creativity and hands-on skills will be key to experiment with ideas, assess their feasibility and potential value and help promising concepts to move forward. Your work may span AI, automation, analytics, data and integration, depending on the problem at hand.

You will be expected to learn quickly, navigate ambiguity and find pragmatic ways to solve operational challenges, taking ideas from initial exploration towards solutions that can create value for the business.

Location Virum

Experience 2 - 5 Years

Department Global IT

**How You Might Spend Your Days

**As an AI Innovation Engineer you’ll be:

• Collaborating with AI Partners, engineering specialists, and business stakeholders to understand challenges, explore workflows, and identify where AI can create meaningful value.

• Rapidly experimenting with, building and testing AI-enabled solutions using approved development tools and platforms, and helping successful ideas mature and scale where relevant.

• Translating business needs into practical technical approaches and assessing feasibility, data readiness, implementation complexity, security and other relevant risks.

• Connecting models, data, systems and workflows to quickly test ideas, learn from users and iterate based on feedback and observed results.

• Capturing and sharing technical learnings, reusable components and successful approaches, and communicating technical options and trade-offs clearly to both technical and non-technical audience.

**Who You Are

**We care about who you are as a person. In the end, how you work, and your energy is what impacts the results we achieve as a team. As a person, you are:

• Curious and practical, with the confidence to explore possibilities while staying focused on solving a real user or business problem.

• Comfortable moving between conversations with stakeholders and hands-on development, and able to turn ambiguity into a testable next step.

• Collaborative and respectful of different professional, individual, and cultural perspectives.

• Open about uncertainty, trade-offs, and risks, and willing to seek input when a decision requires specialist knowledge.

• Motivated by continuous learning, experimentation and sharing knowledge that helps others move faster.

**What You Bring To The Role

• A bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, software engineering, data science, information technology, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

• Hands-on experience with Python, APIs, integrations, and data. Knowledge of AI solution patterns (MCP, RAG, tool calling, agentic AI) and platforms such as Azure AI, Power Platform, or Microsoft Fabric is an advantage.

• Solid understanding of AI models, their capabilities and limitations, and how they influence solution design.

• AI-first mindset, using AI-assisted development to rapidly explore, build, test, and refine solutions.

• Experience working directly with business and technical stakeholders to understand problems, explore options and translate needs into practical technical approaches

**Life at NNE

**NNE is short for Novo Nordisk Engineering. And for all of us who work here, NNE means so much more.

At NNE, you become part of a vibrant, project-based environment built on close day-to-day collaboration. The role is therefore primarily on-site, with physical presence at the workplace expected five days a week. Limited flexibility for occasional remote work may be accommodated in line with business needs.

We are, at our core, a people business and, as such, committed to continuously developing our people and the way we work together. We therefore welcome new colleagues with our award-nominated onboarding programme, supported by a range of in-house talent and development initiatives designed to support your long-term growth.

You can read more about the benefits we offer **here .

**Questions before applying? Send us a quick text to arrange a convenient time to chat. Contact Ivanna Jurkiv Ditlevsen at +45 3077 4721.

**Please note:

**

• You do not need to attach a cover letter, but please include a few sentences about why you are applying in your resume or CV

• We invite to interviews on a running basis.

**Fair hiring:

**At NNE, we are committed to an inclusive recruitment process and equal opportunities for all job applicants. To maintain fairness, we request that you refrain from including a personal photo in your CV.

jobs.occupation: Assistant Professors in Electronic Systems (with the possibility of tenure-track)
jobs.description:
At the Technical Faculty of IT and Design, Department of Electronic Systems, one or more positions as Assistant Professor in Electronic Systems are open for appointments from June 1, 2027, or soon after. The positions are full-time and available for a period of 4 years (with the possibility of tenure-track).

Who we are
In electronic engineering, Aalborg University is known worldwide for its high academic quality and societal impact. The Department of Electronic Systems employs more than 200 people, of which about 90 are PhD students, and about 40 % of all employees are internationals. In total, it has more than 700 students in its BSc and MSc programs, which are based on AAU's problem-based learning model.

The department leverages its unique research infrastructure and lab facilities to conduct world-leading fundamental and applied research within one or more of the following areas: communication, networks, control systems, AI, sound, computing, cyber security, quantum technology, and robotics. The department plays an active role in transferring inventions and results into applications in close collaboration with industrial partners worldwide.

The department places significant emphasis on supporting early career researchers and provides comprehensive career and personal development programmes, specifically designed to assist individual academics in achieving their professional objectives.

You can read more about the department at www.es.aau.dk.

Your profile and work tasks
We seek to appoint one or more Assistant Professors (with the possibility of Tenure-Track) to conduct research, teaching, and knowledge exchange, and to grow and develop the department's research activities within our subject fields.
The positions require internationally recognized research experience within one or more of the following areas:

• Communication
• Networks
• Antennas
• Control systems
• Sound
• Artifical intelligence
• Signal Processing
• Computing
• Quantum technology 
• Robotics

The main tasks and responsibilities include:
• developing a research profile and providing valuable contributions to science.
• providing research-based teaching and supervision within at least one subject area.
• participating in grant application activities
• coordinating own projects and contributing to an active academic environment.

Your competencies
You have an interest in collaborating with external partners and experience from participating in grant applications. You have also contributed to workplace well-being, collaboration, equal treatment, diversity, and a good working environment.
Selected candidates should demonstrate development potential in science and have peer-reviewed publications in recognized journals and books or anthologies. Under the leadership of others, you can plan and carry out individual teaching and supervision activities with a focus on the students' learning.

Qualification requirements
Applicants must have academic qualifications at PhD level. The potential of each applicant will be emphasized in the overall assessment

Tenure Track

When appointing tenure track assistant professors, Aalborg University also place particular emphasis on: 

• The candidate can demonstrate a high degree of autonomy in their previous education and employment path
• The candidate shows considerable potential and is among the best in their field
• The candidate has academic experience from several universities and/or research institutions and preferably international experience
• The candidate is a skilled communicator
• The candidate writes and speaks English at the academic level
• The candidate is expected to meet the criteria for permanent employment as an associate professor at Aalborg University at the end of the tenure track process
Assessment in connection with transfer to associate professorship
The assessment in connection with transition to tenure as an associate professor normally takes place in the final six months of the tenure track assistant professors’ employment. However, the employee may request that an assessment take place at an earlier time in the first four years. If this assessment finds that the employee is not academically qualified, they may request another assessment within the final six months of their period of employment. A maximum of two assessments may take place. 

The assessment, on transition to the associate professorship, will as a minimum, emphasize the following qualifications in relation to the scientific subject area of the tenure track assistant professorship: 

• Research qualifications equivalent to the level that can be achieved on the basis of satisfactorily completed employment as tenure track assistant professor.
• Documented scientific production at international level. Assessment will be based on up to ten selected publications selected by the employee.
• Documentation of pedagogical supervision and upgrading of qualifications, including a positive written assessment of teaching qualifications. The assessment will also be based on the employee's teaching portfolio.
• The level of contribution to an active academic environment as well as the ability to collaborate and build relationships.
• The level of experience with grant proposals and experience of communicating research to relevant stakeholders. 
If the tenure track assistant professor fails to request that their qualifications be assessed in the last year of their period of employment or if they are assessed as not academically qualified, the university must immediately initiate dismissal proceedings in accordance with the collective agreement rules.
